context.title: Castro LGBTQ Cultural District: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Contributions to the Housing Fund)

positions.statement: Castro LGBTQ Cultural District signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition C in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Castro LGBTQ Cultural District signed the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition D in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Castro LGBTQ Cultural District signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
